bake_A_ppo_scratch.name: bake_scratch
bake_A_ppo_scratch.note: Bake-off candidate A: PPO from scratch (random 2x128 network) on the real task only. Reward: game score + 200 for resting between the flags, -100 off-pad rest, -100 timeout.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Learns to fly and land within ~10-20M steps; unlikely to beat the 84% pilot within 45 minutes.

bake_B_ppo_warm.name: bake_warm
bake_B_ppo_warm.note: Bake-off candidate B: PPO warm-started from the behaviour clone of pilot v2 (2x128, 83.5%), critic trained alone for 15 iterations first on the real task only. Reward: game score + 200 for resting between the flags, -100 off-pad rest, -100 timeout.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Starts at ~84% and climbs, as gradients use every step of experience. Risk: the first updates damage the clone.
